message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm when I glanced at my phone and saw the battery icon turning red. Talk about a wake-up call! I realized that if I had to call for help, my trusty device might not be so trusty. It got me thinking about how important it is to have a backup plan, like a good old-fashioned landline or even just knowing your neighbors' numbers by heart. Have you ever had your tech fail you at a crucial moment?
